message.content: {"note_claim": "Walmart is not closing stores to in-person shopping on November 1st and has made no such announcement; the rumor tying SNAP/EBT to closures is false.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "the claims are false, as Walmart has not announced any closure of its physical stores, and certainly not due to the lapse of SNAP benefits.", "reason": "The Hindustan Times fact-check directly states Walmart has announced no store closures and that the SNAP-related rumor is false, matching the note's core claims."}

parsed.note_claim: Walmart is not closing stores to in-person shopping on November 1st and has made no such announcement; the rumor tying SNAP/EBT to closures is false.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: the claims are false, as Walmart has not announced any closure of its physical stores, and certainly not due to the lapse of SNAP benefits.
parsed.reason: The Hindustan Times fact-check directly states Walmart has announced no store closures and that the SNAP-related rumor is false, matching the note's core claims.
